products.name: Golden Fractures
products.medium: Mixed media on canvas with POP and metallic gold
products.description: A contemporary textured artwork inspired by the beauty of cracked stone and the Japanese Kintsugi philosophy. A bold statement piece designed to add a luxurious and artistic character to any interior.
